prompts.name: rust-performance-editorial
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: striking premium technical editorial cover for Crabrix Rust blog, 1536x1024 wide landscape 3:2. Show an orange crab engineer in an elegant optical measurement laboratory on a midnight navy background. Two parallel brass inspection rails carry identical ivory input cards towards matched jade measuring gates; on one rail many translucent duplicate cards accumulate, on the other a precise small jade inspection window examines an original card without copying it. The crab holds a magnifying lens and a small plain clipboard, actively inspecting the mechanism. Refined tactile 3D and cut-paper materials, warm ivory highlights, coral-orange crab, jade glass, restrained brass, dramatic soft studio lighting, sophisticated negative space and depth, engineering magazine quality. Clearly recognizable friendly crab with two claws and small legs. No existing game/commercial characters.

prompts.name: rust-performance-allocations-infographic
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: technically precise educational Rust infographic, 1536x1024 wide landscape 3:2. Premium midnight navy background, large warm ivory sans-serif text, jade borrowed-data path, coral owned-data path, restrained brass outlines, refined editorial layout. Exact title: "Remove unnecessary work". Two clearly separated horizontal rows. Top row heading exactly "Own a lowercase copy" and three large boxes connected left-to-right: "Trim line", "Lowercase whole line", "Check prefix". Show multiple small ivory letter tiles duplicated into a coral tray beside its middle box. Below top row exact note "Creates an owned String". Bottom row heading exactly "Borrow a byte prefix" and boxes connected left-to-right: "Trim line", "Get first 5 bytes", "Compare ASCII case". Show a jade transparent five-cell inspection window lying over original ivory tiles, with no duplicate tray. Below bottom row exact note "Short line: no match". A separate bottom footer exactly "Line scanning and trimming still apply". Tiny orange crab engineer near the lower row, subordinate to diagram. Do not add numerical performance results, percentages, charts, code blocks or additional text. Do not imply total work is constant-time: both paths still process input lines. Large readable labels, generous clear spacing, straight unambiguous arrows, no logos/watermark.

prompts.name: rust-performance-measurement-infographic
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: analytical infographic for Rust benchmark methodology, 1536x1024 wide landscape 3:2. A sophisticated scientific editorial board on midnight navy, warm ivory large text, jade arrows, brass separators and coral verification accents. Exact title: "A benchmark is a controlled comparison". Four numbered large cards laid out in a spacious 2x2 grid, clear thin arrows 1 to 2 to 3 to 4, no extra loops. Card 1 text exactly "Prove equivalent results" with a pair of matching ivory result tokens. Card 2 exactly "Build the same profile" with two identical jade compiler blocks. Card 3 exactly "Time equivalent work" with a plain clock icon, no numbered dial. Card 4 exactly "Repeat and inspect variation" with several qualitative unscaled sample marks, no fabricated axes or values. A clearly separated footer sentence exactly "Prepare inputs before timing. Print after timing." Below it a smaller but readable final line exactly "Desktop observations do not predict iPhone timing". A small orange crab scientist on the side holding a lens, subordinate to cards. Do not include speedup claims, percentages, measured seconds, fake code, logos or watermark. Preserve immaculate spacing and arrow routing, highly readable labels, complete text inside safe margins.
